title: Weather forecast for Porto Alegre this Wednesday
seoTitle: Porto Alegre weather forecast for Wednesday
subtitle: Sunny day with temperatures ranging from 15 °C up to 32 °C and low chance of rain
excerpt: Porto Alegre will have clear skies, temperatures up to 32 °C and low humidity this Wednesday, with no rain expected.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the morning of this Wednesday, October 7, the capital of Rio Grande do Sul records clear sunny weather with temperatures ranging from 15 °C to 32 °C, with no sign of rain. This condition has sparked interest among those planning to go out, as the weather favors outdoor activities.

Temperatures throughout the day

Thermometers start the day around 15 °C to 16 °C in the early hours. The warming progresses gradually, reaching between 24 °C and 27 °C in the early afternoon, and possibly hitting 32 °C at peak hours, according to forecasts. At night, values drop to the 19 °C–24 °C range.

Humidity and feels-like temperature

Relative humidity swings between 52 % and 63 % during the drier periods, climbing to 97 % at the most humid hours, according to Climatempo. This variation influences the feels‑like temperature, which stays around 19 °C throughout the day.

Winds and direction

Winds blow predominantly from the east‑southeast, with an average speed of 9 km/h according to Climatempo and 16.09 km/h as reported by Portal O Dia, with gusts up to 27.9 km/h.

Sky and rain probability

The sky remains mostly cloudy, but with sun openings that ensure good brightness. The probability of precipitation is nil, keeping the weather dry for the entire period.

Recommendations for the public

With the dry and hot climate, it is recommended to avoid prolonged sun exposure between 10 a.m. and 4 p.m., especially during temperature peaks. The favorable weather also eases travel and outdoor activities, requiring only attention to the temperature variation between morning and afternoon.

Information from Terra, Portal O Dia.
